progression_tree.description: Bounty Hunter Operators leverage vehicles, drones, and pursuit technology to track, intercept, and disable targets with surgical efficiency.

You excel at vehicular chases and tactical pursuit. You have advantage on Dexterity (Piloting) checks during chases. When piloting, you can Dash as a bonus action a number of times per short rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

effects.notes: Advantage on Piloting checks during chases
Dash as bonus action while piloting (limited uses)

progression_tree.description: You can deploy a compact tracking drone (AC 15, HP equal to your level, fly 40 ft). As a bonus action, command it to Scout (reveal hidden creatures within 30 ft, DC based on your proficiency + INT) or Mark (tag a visible target within 60 ft; you and allies have advantage on checks to track that target for 1 hour).

effects.notes: Drone can Scout or Mark using bonus action commands

progression_tree.description: You can attempt to disable enemy vehicles or electronic locks. As an action within 60 ft, force an opposed check (Technology vs target system DC). On success against a vehicle, reduce its speed by half and impose disadvantage on its Piloting checks for 1 minute (repeat save at end of each of its turns). On success against a lock or door, open/disable it.

effects.notes: Disable/impair vehicle systems or electronic locks remotely

progression_tree.description: Once per short rest, as an action, you can fire an EMP net (60 ft line, 5 ft wide). Devices, drones, and droids in the line must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn; vehicles suffer disadvantage on Piloting checks and lose Dash/Disengage until the end of your next turn.

effects.notes: Stun/impair electronics and vehicles in a line

progression_tree.description: Enter a heightened operations state for 1 minute (once per long rest). During this time, you have advantage on Piloting and Technology checks, your drone’s speed increases by 20 ft, and your vehicle ignores nonmagical difficult terrain.

effects.notes: Advantage on Piloting and Technology checks

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Standing with feet shoulder-width apart, lightsaber held high in a defensive stance
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A swirling aura of blue and white energy emanating from the character's hands and robes

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A seasoned Jedi Knight standing tall on a misty Dagobah morning
contextual_modifiers: In a quiet moment of contemplation
With a faint glow of the Force surrounding them

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Elite warriors who use their skills to disable and capture targets, often working with or for the Empire.
